iti31:1.1: (Duk. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti31:2.1: Dve-me bhikkhave dhammā atapanīyā. Katame dve? Idha bhikkhave ekacco katakalyāṇo hoti kata-kusalo katabhīruttāṇo, akatapāpo akatatthaddho akata-kibbiso. So kataṃ me kalyāṇan-ti pi na tappati, akataṃ me pāpan-ti pi na tappati. Ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā atapanīyā ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti31:3.1: Kāyaduccaritam hitvā vacīduccaritāni vā | manoduccaritaṃ hitvā yañcaññaṃ dosasaññitaṃ ||
iti31:4.1: akatvākusalaṃ kammaṃ katvāna kusalaṃ bahuṃ | kāyassa bhedā sappañño saggaṃ so upapajjatīti ||
iti31:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||4||
